tasks.answer: Use the feature-level DeleteDiscussion destructive confirmation control, passing the discussion id. The generic shared ConfirmationDialog (ui.dialog.confirmation-dialog.ConfirmationDialog, required triggerButton/confirmButton/title) is only for building a custom confirmation prompt.

LoginForm's email/password fields use the shared Input. It binds react-hook-form through the required `registration` prop (the object returned by register('email')/register('password')), which is spread onto the native input; label and error come from FieldWrapper, so Input must be used inside Form. Production example: src/features/auth/components/login-form.tsx.
The discussion list uses TablePagination, a page-number control that builds hrefs from a root URL and the current page. It requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl.
MDPreview renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; it takes the Markdown source via the required `value` prop.
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form for creating a discussion (title plus Markdown body); it requires admin permission and takes no required props.

notes: One search per task, except task 2 which needed a second search: the first query ('login form input react-hook-form') returned Form/LoginForm but not the field component, so a single follow-up entity search ('Input text field') found ui.form.Input. One get total (ui.form.Input with constraints+examples) to confirm the react-hook-form `registration` binding; no other task needed type details because search already returned importPath, requiredProps and summary. No project files read (filesRead empty, 0 bytes); generic ConfirmationDialog alternative noted from task-1 search results without an extra lookup.
